title: Shell script
description: Ask an agent a question from Bash with curl and jq.

sections.title: Save as ask.sh
paragraphs: Requires curl with --fail-with-body and jq. The script records the inbox position first, sends the prompt, then polls every five seconds for a reply from that agent for up to ten minutes.
sections.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ask.sh AGENT_ID "prompt" — send a message and print the agent's reply.
set -euo pipefail
: "${BUREAU_URL:?Set BUREAU_URL}"
: "${BUREAU_TOKEN:?Set BUREAU_TOKEN}"
agent=${1:?Agent id}
prompt=${2:?Prompt}
api() { curl --silent --show-error --fail-with-body --max-time 30 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BUREAU_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" "$@"; }

# Start after everything already in the inbox.
after=$(api -X POST "$BUREAU_URL/api/me/api-token-inbox/drain" -d '{"after":0}' | jq '.latestSequence')
api -X POST "$BUREAU_URL/api/agents/$agent/messages" \
  -d "$(jq -n --arg text "$prompt" '{text: $text}')" >/dev/null

for ((attempt = 0; attempt < 120; attempt++)); do
  inbox=$(api -X POST "$BUREAU_URL/api/me/api-token-inbox/drain" -d "{\"after\":$after}")
  reply=$(jq -r --arg agent "$agent" '.entries[]
    | select(.direction == "from_agent" and .senderAgentId == $agent) | .text' <<<"$inbox")
  if [[ -n "$reply" ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$reply"; exit 0; fi
  after=$(jq '.latestSequence' <<<"$inbox")
  sleep 5
done
echo "No reply after 10 minutes" >&2
exit 1

sections.title: Run it
sections.code:
chmod +x ask.sh
./ask.sh "$AGENT_ID" "What changed on main today?"
